title.suggested: Allen and Rooke to Meet Thursday Week

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that the Allen-Rooke fight for the championship of America was set for Thursday week within fifty miles of Pittsburg, with all the money up and Allen winning the choice of ground.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, June 9, 1875', page 5.

facts.fact: Allen's fight with George Rooke of Newark, N.J., for the championship of America was set for Thursday week (June 17) within fifty miles of Pittsburg
The last deposit for the Allen-Rooke fight was put up at Harry Hill's in New York; Arthur Chambers and Billy Edwards acted for Allen and won the toss for choice of fighting ground
